privacy_intro: This website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience, display personalized content, and gather usage statistics.
privacy_type_necessary: Essential for the proper functioning of the site (e.g., navigation, security).
privacy_type_functional: Enable features like sharing on social networks.
privacy_type_analytics: Used to analyze website traffic and improve content.
privacy_type_ads: Used to display personalized ads based on your activity.
privacy_change_preferences: You can modify your cookie preferences at any time by clicking the 'Customize cookies' button or by clearing cookies from your browser.
privacy_contact_intro: If you have any questions about personal data protection, please contact us using the site’s contact form.
privacy_rp_intro1: As part of our operations, Électrotech Industrial Automation collects and uses personal data at various levels and from various stakeholders. As a private organization, Électrotech is subject to the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector. The company is responsible for ensuring compliance with this obligation.
privacy_rp_intro2: This policy aims to help you understand our practices regarding the collection, use, disclosure, and retention of personal information.
privacy_rp_collect_title: When do we collect personal information and what types?
privacy_rp_collect_emploi: When you apply for a job at our company: this usually involves providing a resume and a cover letter that may include your name, address, phone number, email, and other personal details.
privacy_rp_collect_email: When you contact us by email: we collect your email address and any information you include.
privacy_rp_usage_title: Why do we collect personal information and who do we share it with?
privacy_rp_usage_identify: To identify a person during the hiring process (check matching profiles, backgrounds, communication, and potential hiring);
privacy_rp_usage_legal: To comply with legal requirements (e.g., tax, CNESST);
privacy_rp_limit: We limit the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal data strictly to the purposes we have informed you of. Your data is only accessed by authorized staff as part of their assigned duties.
privacy_rp_retention_title: How long do we retain personal information?
privacy_rp_retention: We retain your personal data only for the time necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected. Once those purposes are fulfilled, we take reasonable steps to destroy your data and maintain confidentiality until the end.
privacy_rp_rights_consult: You can request access to the personal information we hold about you.
privacy_rp_rights_exact: We are responsible for ensuring the data we hold about you is accurate and up to date.
privacy_rp_rights_correction: You may request correction of your personal data if it is inaccurate or outdated.
privacy_rp_rights_contact: If you have any questions or concerns, please contact the person responsible using the information above.
privacy_update: Last updated: August 31, 2024. This policy is reviewed annually and updated upon significant legal or regulatory changes.
